name: Dust Shaman
flavour: Kill it first. Everyone around it agrees.
art_prompt: a small hunched goblin shaman in a tattered sand-coloured robe and a bone mask with feathers, holding a crooked wooden staff topped with a glowing green skull, beads and bones around its neck, standing on the ground
motion: swaying in place and shaking the staff, the green skull pulsing
doc: Keeps seven metres off and every four seconds mends the creatures around it for a quarter of their health and drives them for three seconds (a green ring, green sparks on each). Kill it first.
